data_types: Smart meter consumption data (electricity, water, gas)
project_info.network_architecture: Cloud-based distributed architecture utilizing message broker pattern with Apache Kafka for real-time streaming, MQTT/CoAP protocols for device communication over TLS, and AWS IoT Core as cloud gateway. Time-series data storage separated from operational database.
key_components: Data Processing Engine (real-time analytics, anomaly detection)
